source_caption_text:
Thug really needs to hear himself again 🤒

“Fetish (Remix)” brings together Lil Keed and Young Thug over a dark, bouncy Mooktoven beat, with both artists showing off the unpredictable flows and melodies that made this era of Atlanta rap so special. Keed already had his own sound, but hearing him trade energy with Thug makes it clear where some of that inspiration came from.

It also makes you realise how badly Young Thug needs to be forced to sit down and listen to his old music. His delivery, the way he stretched words, switched his voice and came up with melodies that nobody else would think of trying, was genuinely something else. He could make the strangest vocal choices sound natural, and that creativity influenced an entire generation of artists.

Listening back to records like this is a reminder of just how special Thug’s music was during that period. Keed carried parts of that sound forward in his own way, and their chemistry on this remix is still something worth going back to.
